# AVB fixtures

`unsigned_vbmeta.img` is a synthetic, unsigned VBMeta image generated by AOSP
`avbtool` 1.3.0 from the pinned research tree
(`external/avb`, commit `c66af46cc55138dd6ee70b51cbeb4501b83d23ec`).

Generation command:

```text
python avbtool.py make_vbmeta_image \
  --algorithm NONE \
  --prop test.key:test-value \
  --kernel_cmdline "androidboot.test=1" \
  --output unsigned_vbmeta.img
```

Expected SHA-256:
`df3d0b84fce2abbf0ebdcebbec571cbc2d4b089dca88cf3ab8214c610059b405`

The image is an oracle artifact, not a trusted package. It contains no signature
and is only used to check header and descriptor parsing against `avbtool`.
